Name: Baby Serpents (Custom Critters)
Author: lavaheart
Description:
Requires[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400] SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1255]Custom Critters Mod
[/url]
[size=4][u]Installation:

[/u][/size]1. Download the file you wish to use
﻿- I highly recommend only picking the "vanilla" version if your desert map is small, and the "SVE" version if you have a large desert map. I do not recommend installing both since it would be a lot of lizards flying around.

2. Extract your files and place inside your mods folder.
﻿- The file will be named "Custom Critter" so that the files get inserted directly into the correct folder hassle free.
﻿

FAQ:
-

Q: I chose the SVE version but no serpents are appearing in the badlands?

A: Sorry I'm not sure why exactly, but you have to exit the area and re-enter for them to spawn, I honestly have no idea why the mod acts differently for that area.

-

Q: Too many serpents are spawning?

A: The spawn rates can be adjusted be lowering "SpawnAttempts": in this mod's critter.json file. The default for vanilla is 7 and the default for SVE is 20. If you wish to make the serpents not spawn every day you can adjust the "Chance": to be a decimal.

-

Q: Can I get baby serpents to spawn in the skull cavern dungeon?

A: You could add the underground mine maps that correlate to the skull cavern manually... but since skull cavern is infinite if you dig too deep then they would stop spawning. I'm more of an art person than a code person, so I wasn't sure how to actually code it to work in a situation like that.
